module i3c_controller_unpack (
  input         clk,
  input         reset_n,
  input         stop,

  output        u32_ready,
  input         u32_valid,
  input  [31:0] u32,

  output [11:0] u8_lvl,

  input         u8_ready,
  output        u8_valid,
  output [7:0]  u8
);

  localparam [0:0] SM_GET = 0;
  localparam [0:0] SM_PUT = 1;

  reg [0:0]  sm;
  reg [1:0]  c;
  reg [11:0] u8_lvl_reg;
  reg [31:0] u32_reg;

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!reset_n | stop) begin
      sm <= SM_GET;
      c <= 2'b00;
      u8_lvl_reg <= 0;
    end else begin
      case (sm)
        SM_GET: begin
          if (u32_valid) begin
            sm <= SM_PUT;
          end
          u32_reg <= u32;
          c <= 2'b00;
        end
        SM_PUT: begin
          if (u8_ready) begin // tick
            u8_lvl_reg <= u8_lvl_reg + 12'b1;
            c <= c + 1;
            if (c == 2'b11) begin
              sm <= SM_GET;
            end
            u32_reg <= u32_reg >> 8;
          end
        end
      endcase
    end
  end

  assign u32_ready = sm == SM_GET & (reset_n | stop);
  assign u8_valid = sm == SM_PUT;
  assign u8_lvl = u8_lvl_reg;
  assign u8 = u32_reg[7:0];

endmodule
